name: Kettlebell Lateral Squat Clean
description: A power transition out of the bottom of a lateral lunge. With the kettlebell swung down between the legs, drive explosively out of the lateral-lunge stance and clean the bell up to the rack position as you come up into a lateral squat stance. Catch the clean with soft knees and zero impact at the rack. Combines a lateral-plane leg drive with a clean — leg and hip power generate the clean, the arm just guides. Land softly, stay tall through the spine.
